claims: McDaniel College is a private four-year liberal arts college.
McDaniel College is in Westminster, Maryland.
McDaniel College was founded in 1867.
McDaniel College has a 160-acre campus.
McDaniel College has ~1,600 undergraduates.
McDaniel College has a 13:1 student-faculty ratio.
McDaniel College has a European branch in Budapest.
McDaniel College has a "College That Changes Lives" designation.
McDaniel College offers over 70 undergraduate programs.
McDaniel College offers undergraduate majors in Business Administration and Psychology.
McDaniel College offers master's degrees.
McDaniel College offers teacher certification.
SAT/ACT scores are not strictly required for admission to McDaniel College.
A minimum score of 1030 is recommended for consideration for admission to McDaniel College.
~80% of McDaniel College students live on campus.
McDaniel College has Greek life.
McDaniel College has NCAA Division III athletics.
Over 90% of McDaniel College students receive financial aid.
McDaniel College provides over $40 million in grants/scholarships annually.
McDaniel College was originally named Western Maryland College.
McDaniel College was renamed to McDaniel College in 2002.
Business Administration and Management has the highest starting salaries at approximately $79,062 at McDaniel College.
McDaniel College offers a 5-year B.A./M.S. program.
McDaniel College hosts "Traditions Weeks" during the summer.
